identifier: WooPayments built in partnership with Stripe
statement: When you sign up for WooPayments, you verify your personal and business information with Stripe. This creates a Stripe Express account that is connected to the WooPayments service.

identifier: How quickly will you confirm my identity?
statement: We’ll do our best to work with Stripe to confirm your identity as quickly as we can.
Because the payments sector is heavily regulated, we must gather certain information from you before you’ll be able to use WooPayments.

identifier: How do I delete my WooPayments account?
statement: WooPayments accounts contain information that we must retain for tax and compliance purposes.
